figure/design/reference/style-target.web.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, style-transfer. The reference image is Inner Breeze's Tai Chi practice banner: match its exact illustration style (calm handmade 2D storybook illustration, subtle paper grain, softly shaded forms, crisp restrained contours, clear daylight palette). Draw ONE slim, graceful, cute young Chinese woman doing a Tai Chi bow stance (brush knee and push) in three-quarter view, full body, portrait 3:4 framing with the whole figure in the centre. Soft round face, gentle almond eyes, small nose and small mouth, calm friendly smile, sleek glossy black hair in a neat high bun. She wears an elegant fitted jade-green silk Tai Chi top with a stand-up mandarin collar and cream frog-knot buttons down the front, hip length with side slits, long sleeves, and flowing deep navy-blue silk trousers, black cloth shoes. Background like the reference: a stone terrace above a calm lake with misty blue mountains, pine trees only at the edges. Strong figure/background contrast. Tasteful, not revealing. No text, logos, watermarks or extra people.
